targets.expr: sum (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})

sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
*
(
    sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
    -
    1
)
/
sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
count(kube_node_info * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})

sum by(node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Pending|Running|Terminating)$"} == 1) * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (namespace,pod) group_left(phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Pending|Running|Terminating)$"} == 1) * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
sum by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
sum(kube_node_status_capacity{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})

sum (
    sum by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
    * on(namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (
        kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1
    )
)
- sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})

sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
*
(
    sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
    -
    1
)
/
sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})

avg by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
-
avg by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left kube_node_spec_taint{effect="NoSchedule",key=~"$taint_key",value=~"$taint_value"})
> 0

panels.description: CPU request is less than the average daily usage, and at least 10m under-reservation

targets.expr:
topk(20,
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (avg_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    -
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    > 0.010
)
and
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    > 0
)
and
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (avg_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    /
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    > 1
)
)

panels.title: Top CPU under reservation / daily average

panels.description: CPU request is more than twice the 99 percentile daily usage, and at least 10m over-reservation

targets.expr:
topk(20,
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    -
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (quantile_over_time(0.99,rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",container!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    > 0.01
) and (
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (quantile_over_time(0.99,rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",container!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    /
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    < 1
)
)
